subject: Shadow-bucket invoice reconciliation for cross-entity seats
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@novamed.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T08:12:00Z
Subject: Shadow-bucket invoice reconciliation for cross-entity seats

Hi Olga and Karthik,

Quick note from finance: our automated collections report flagged ~€124,000 in unsettled invoice lines from October. It looks like seat charges were emitted to a shadow bucket (entity: Novamed-EU-Shadow) instead of the operating entity (Novamed-EU-OPS), which prevented our AP system from applying the cost-center mappings and VAT reclaim workflow.

I've attached a CSV with the affected invoice rows (invoice-split-202610.csv). Can you confirm whether this was a Redwood-side routing rule change or something on our remit config? We have a quarter-end close next week and we need to either reissue corrected invoices or have Redwood re-route payments to the correct fiscal entity so our bank reconciliation works.

Also noted some lines are missing a VAT registration ID on the remit, which is blocking netting. Any quick mitigation we can take to unblock payment processing?

Thanks — would appreciate a triage ETA today if possible.

— Anna Lopez
Head of Finance, Novamed Health
anna.lopez@novamed.com
[attachment: invoice-split-202610.csv (text/csv)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Shadow-bucket invoice reconciliation for cross-entity seats

Hi Anna — thanks for the file and the heads-up. I've ingested the CSV and started a quick audit. Initial findings:

- Several invoice rows were served from a legacy remit profile that maps to the temporary "Novamed-EU-Shadow" ledger. That profile was meant for a short pilot and should have been retired during the migration on 2026-10-20.
- A subset (~€19k) also lacks the VAT reg ID on the remit payload, which causes your AP system to hold those lines.

Immediate options to unblock collections:
1) Quick fix (preferred short-term): We can emit a remediation invoice patch for the affected invoice rows that points to Novamed-EU-OPS and includes the VAT id field. This will generate credit/debit line-items and a reconciliation reference your AP can match. It takes ~24 hours to run and push to your accounting export.
2) Alternate fix: Update remit routing in the Redwood console to remap the shadow profile to the OPS ledger and trigger an on-demand re-export of outstanding invoice rows. This is faster to surface in your exports but will keep the original invoice numbers (we can add a reconciliation token).

I asked Ben (payments ops) to scope option 2 if you prefer routing change. Karthik — I ran a quick check on modelled routes vs. ledger assignments and I think there is a mismatch in the mapping table (pilot profile wasn't garbage-collected). I can push a temporary policy to force-route to OPS for Novamed while we do a full cleanup.

Anna — are you able to confirm whether Novamed prefers reissue (option 1) or routing patch (option 2)? If you want reissue, please confirm which invoice numbers we should operate on (list in the CSV).

Regards,
Olga
Senior Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
[attachment: reviewed-invoice-rows-stub.txt (text/plain)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Shadow-bucket invoice reconciliation for cross-entity seats

Thanks Olga — dug into the ledger mapping. Short summary of technical cause and a recommended path: 

Cause: During the Oct 20 migration we introduced a temporary remit profile (ID: REMIT-NUV-202610-TEMP) to support seat migration. The cleanup job that should have decommissioned that profile failed due to a schema change in the cost-center tag parser; as a result, late-arriving usage records continued to inherit the temporary remit profile. Those records were routed to Novamed-EU-Shadow.

Recommendation (two-step):
A) Immediate remediation (24h): Force a re-route of outstanding invoice rows from Novamed-EU-Shadow -> Novamed-EU-OPS and update the export with the VAT ID where missing (we can pull VAT id from your tenant profile). This will let your AP consume the export and post payments.
B) Prevent recurrence (next deploy): Add a pre-flight validation that prevents ephemeral remit profiles from matching once the tenant has an active OPS remit (guard on remit_profile.active == true && tenant.migration_state != "pending"). I attached a short mapping proposal that shows the changes (mapping-proposal-entity-ledger.xlsx).

Ben — the re-route needs a payments ops runbook: safe order is (1) snapshot current outstanding rows, (2) patch routing metadata to OPS for those row IDs, (3) push re-export to your accounting S3, (4) post remediation summary incident for your AP team. Can you confirm ETA for step 2?

Anna — if you confirm you want the re-route we will proceed with A immediately. If you prefer invoice reissue, confirm which invoice numbers should be reissued and we'll draft the credits.

— Karthik
Principal Product Manager, Invoicing
Redwood Inference
[attachment: mapping-proposal-entity-ledger.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-05T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Shadow-bucket invoice reconciliation for cross-entity seats

Anna — quick update from payments ops: we executed the re-route for the 128 affected row IDs this morning and re-exported the accounting CSV to your S3 bucket. Items to note: 

- Re-route completed and re-export generated: point your AP at s3://novamed-billing/exports/2026-11-05-remit-reexport.csv (same file your team uses).
- VAT ID injection: we filled missing VAT IDs from the tenant profile where present; 4 rows still require manual VAT confirmation (we flagged them in the export with RECONCILE:VAT_REQUIRED).
- No invoice numbers were changed; we added a reconciliation token in the export column (remit_recon_token) to help your bank reconcile previous statements.

Action items: 
1) Novamed AP: pull the remitted CSV and attempt to clear the 124k EUR batches. For the 4 VAT rows, confirm the VAT reg ID by replying to this thread.
2) Redwood: we'll schedule the prevent-recurrence pre-flight validation in the Nov 10 deploy (Karthik to own).
3) Follow-up: I'll post an incident summary and run the postmortem with the infra team; expect that by EOD 2026-11-06.

Anna — apologies for the disruption, and thanks for flagging early. Please confirm when your AP has processed the re-export; we'll keep this ticket open until reconciliation is confirmed.

— Ben Carter
Payments Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
